narrowest_defensible_contribution: A deployment-clean, action-semantic adaptation of a frozen multi-view VLA to complete wrist-view loss: a clean-view teacher supervises a parameter-efficient dropout student at action-hidden or action-token and continuous action-chunk levels; raw gripper margin is preserved separately; cross-view wrist reconstruction is training-only auxiliary supervision and is never inserted into the policy token stream; deployment uses neither teacher, future frame, retrieval library, nor reconstructed input.
claim_conditions: Do not claim multi-camera-to-single-camera policy distillation as novel.
Do not claim cross-view reconstruction, action-centric latent learning, VLA distillation, LoRA, or sensor-dropout training individually as novel.
A method claim is conditional on a practical mechanism effect over the matched no-reconstruction ablation and the matched generic wrist-dropout adaptation control.
A paper claim is conditional on official closed-loop improvement or a preregistered deployment Pareto advantage over MECHANISM_FAITHFUL_RL4IL_LOCAL_PORT.
The reconstructed wrist latent may only define a training loss or legal reliability statistic and may never enter the deployment policy token stream.
strongest_likely_reviewer_objection: The direction is an obvious aggregation of established multi-camera-to-single-camera action/feature distillation, sensor-dropout training, VLA hidden/action distillation, action-guided view invariance, and cross-view reconstruction. Any gain may be fully explained by ordinary wrist-dropout adaptation rather than the proposed reconstruction or gripper-specific mechanism.
why_not_A: Acar et al. already distill multi-camera teacher actions and intermediate features into a deployable single-camera manipulation policy.
VITA-VLA and ActDistill already align VLA hidden/action representations; VITA-VLA separately optimizes continuous arm and binary gripper outputs.
VILA and MVP-LAM already make multi-view representations action-centric using ground-truth action sequences or cross-viewpoint reconstruction.
RME and DisDP already train or structure policies for complete sensor/camera dropout, and DisDP includes an action-chunking diffusion policy baseline with matched dropout training.
why_not_C: No audited prior combines a frozen clean X-VLA teacher with a matched complete-wrist-dropout X-VLA student and jointly preserves action-chunk semantics and a separate raw gripper margin.
No audited prior uses cross-view wrist reconstruction only as an auxiliary regularizer for that missing-view VLA student while forbidding reconstructed images or tokens at inference.
The local campaign has a verified complete wrist-dropout failure and a verified task-dependent residual after the RL4IL local prior, which gives the narrow formulation a concrete empirical target.
The deployment comparison against RL4IL can test a prespecified success/latency/memory/artifact-footprint Pareto claim that the closest representation and reconstruction papers do not address.
